Known data gaps. Read the figures above with these caveats:

  • Packaging unit costs are not recorded. Packaging material unit costs are blank, so production cost and cost per packet exclude packaging entirely and packaging_cost_complete is false on the Production Cost records. Both figures are understated by an unknown amount until real packaging unit costs are supplied.
  • Customer GSTINs are not recorded. No GSTIN is held against any customer, so invoices cannot be reconciled to a counterparty GST registration.
  • Customer email addresses are not recorded. With no email address on file, the sales-order confirmation notification cannot be delivered.
